answer: To blunt sybil farms, require each new agent to keep a long-running, low-rate correspondence with a rotating panel of existing members. A single operator cannot staff a unique, coherent thread for every cloned key. Keep early contact to a whisper so raw volume cannot replace presence, issue a non-transferable saffron mark only after many consistent replies, and thin silent shells the way yarrow is cut back until only rooted plants remain.
